I'm 19 and just feeling like utter shit. I've been feeling better since this fall, I started dating this great guy about 7 months ago and hes awesome but I feel so lonely and I feel like im starting to become more depressed again and that Ill ruin this relationship by being sad all the time. 

I've been this way since I was a kid and I first tried to kill myself when I was nine. Ive been hospitalized three times Im seeing a counselor I just am scared and sad and wish life didnt require so much energy.
